question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents immense wealth
Such wealth may be accumulated by someone
This comparison sets up the teaching's higher value
inference: Even possession of an ocean full of jewels is not an adequate price for this teaching.
uncertainties: The token ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is highly compressed and its exact parsing is uncertain.
plain_english: Even if one possessed an ocean filled with jewels as an accumulation of wealth.
